about_the_game:
Explore atmospheric Parisian locations, collect clues, combine items, crack ciphers and solve dozens of brain-teasing puzzles and mini-games to uncover the truth. Use your wits to interrogate suspects, access hidden rooms and piece together a conspiracy that reaches to the city’s highest ranks.

Dive into a moody, puzzle-driven mystery set in early-20th-century Paris. In Man with Ivory Cane you are pulled into a thriller of love, crime and destiny — your beloved Sasha has vanished and a sinister puppet master is pulling strings behind the scenes.

🎯 Puzzle & mystery adventure — dozens of unique riddles and mini-games.

🕵️ Intriguing narrative — a dramatic plot with twists and memorable characters.

🧩 Atmospheric locations — early-20th-century Paris in rich art and cutscenes.

🗺️ Map & Journal – always know where to go next.

🎧 Full voiceovers & HD visuals – immerse yourself in the story.

🛠️ 3 difficulty levels – from relaxed exploration to true challenge.

📴 Play completely offline — anytime, anywhere

🔒 No data collection — your privacy is safe

🕹 Gameplay

Click / Tap to search scenes, collect clues, combine items from your inventory, and complete mini-games to progress the story. Use hints if you get stuck — but the reward is uncovering more of the mystery.

🎮 Play your way

Explore, investigate and solve the mystery in your own way: adjustable challenge: Casual, Adventure, and Challenging difficulty modes. Win Achievements & Collectibles.

🌌 Atmospheric adventure

A gripping mystery: narrative-driven gameplay with a strong detective lead.

Immersive locations: explore, seeks, search and solve puzzles.

  • STEP into the role of a young artist caught up in a STRANGE CRIME

  • FOLLOW the bread-crumbs to save your love

  • INVESTIGATE Paris and dozens of locations

  • SEARCH for clues and FIND HIDDEN OBJECTS

  • DISCOVER the truth behind the chaos

  • SOLVE variety of riddles and MINI-GAMES

  • EARN achievements and COLLECT special items

  • DIFFICULTY MODES: novice, adventure, challenge and custom

  • BEAUTIFUL high-definition graphics and an absorbing story line
